title: Responsive behaviour: reflow without horizontal overflow at 360, 768, 1024, and 1440
description: Every declared route renders without horizontal overflow at viewport widths 360, 768, 1024, and 1440. Layout reflows rather than scales: content reorganises per breakpoint instead of shrinking. Images carry intrinsic size hints and respond to container width. Data tables below 768 adopt a card layout or an explicit scroll container scoped to the table, never page-level overflow.
rationale: The four breakpoints are the ratified baseline. Overflow at any of them is the single most common visible defect in unspecified builds.
